description: This source file implements DNS configuration management for POSIX systems within the Chromium project, including watching configuration files, reading DNS settings, and converting system resolver state to internal DNS config representations.

classes.name: DnsConfigServicePosix::Watcher
classes.description: Watches DNS configuration and hosts file changes, manages callbacks for configuration updates.

classes.name: DnsConfigServicePosix::ConfigReader
classes.description: Reads DNS configuration asynchronously using a serial worker, converts system resolver state to internal DNS config.

methods.name: ReadDnsConfig
methods.description: Reads current DNS configuration from system resolver state, applies platform-specific checks, and returns optional DNS config.

methods.name: ConvertResStateToDnsConfig
methods.description: Converts system resolver state (__res_state) to internal DnsConfig object.
